Class GameRegistry

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.GameRegistry
public class GameRegistry extends Object
Singleton registry that loads and provides access to all static game data: character cards, event cards, building cards, offer tiles, and turn-order tiles.

All data is loaded from JSON resource files at class-initialization time. Use getInstance() to obtain the single shared instance.

      public void loadCharacters(String charactersPath)
      Loads character cards from the given JSON resource path, replacing any previously loaded characters. Normally called once during construction; exposed for testing with custom data files.
      Parameters:
